title: FIR Decimator
text: Finite impulse response (FIR) decimation filter, 4 inputs, 2 outputs, {Rounding mode} sets Rounding mode for type-casting the output; {Coefficient source} sets the source of filter, {Coefficients} sets the fIR filter coefficients fir1, {Coefficients prototype} sets the prototype filter coefficients, {Filter structure} sets the hDL filter architecture Direct form, {Decimation factor}, {Minimum number of cycles between valid input samples} sets the serialization requirement for input timing, {Optimize symmetric coefficients} sets the share multipliers for symmetric, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the overflow handling for type-casting, {Output} sets the data type of filter output, {Enable reset input port} sets the option to enable reset input port and {Use HDL global reset} sets the option to connect data path registers to generated HDL global reset. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: coeff
ports.summary: Filter coefficients real or complex row vector

params.name: Coefficient source
params.values: Source of filter coefficients Property (default) | Input port (Parallel interface)

params.name: Coefficients
params.values: FIR filter coefficients fir1(35,0.4) (default) | real- or complex-valued vector

params.name: Coefficients prototype
params.values: Prototype filter coefficients [] (default) | real or complex vector

params.name: Filter structure
params.values: HDL filter architecture Direct form systolic (default) | Direct form transposed

params.name: Decimation factor
params.values: Decimation factor 2 (default) | integer greater than two

params.name: Minimum number of cycles between valid input samples
params.values: Serialization requirement for input timing 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Optimize symmetric coefficients
params.values: Share multipliers for symmetric coefficients on (default) | off

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for type-casting the output Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Overflow handling for type-casting the output off (default) | on

params.name: Output
params.values: Data type of filter output Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same word length as input |

params.name: Enable reset input port
params.values: Option to enable reset input port off (default) | on

params.name: Use HDL global reset
params.values: Option to connect data path registers to generated HDL global reset signal off (default) | on
